title: Fixture Addon
description: Hermetic test fixture exercising the addon bundle host pipeline (shell, proxy, merged importmap, mount) — owned by test/system/addon_bundle_test.rb, independent of both the tinkerex-addons repo and the live accessory.

permissions.name: library:write
permissions.reasoning: Saves the box it draws — the cut sheet, and a compartment plan for trays — into the library folder you pick.

permissions.name: service:boxes
permissions.reasoning: Draws every box: the boxes.py generator runs as a separate service, and its SVG is what the preview shows and what gets saved.

title: SDK Fixture
description: Hermetic fixture that touches the host ONLY through @maker/addon-sdk — no raw ctx, no hand-rolled fetch. Owned by test/system/addon_sdk_test.rb. The sibling `fixture` addon deliberately stays on the raw-ctx path so both halves of the compatibility rule are covered by something that runs.

permissions.name: library:read
permissions.reasoning: Reads back what it just wrote, to prove the bytes survived
